slides.title: Maus Crepe Insights
slides.hook: Turn robot run records and camera checks into measurable crêpe-quality signals.
slides.tagline: A data-to-insight toolkit for the Maus Robotics challenge
slides.notes: Introduce the project as a practical data-to-insight toolkit: run records, camera checks and recipe settings become a structured view for analysis. Source: repository documentation and private Maus export. The project code is public; the run data remains private.

slides.title: One run. A richer view.
caveats: Join robot runs, recipe settings and check images in one analysis workflow.
Measure diameter, centre offset, holes and fold overlap from the robot's check overlays.
Review video alongside frame records, then explore model artifacts and follow-up experiments.
slides.notes: The export contains 828 run records; the flat table has 177 columns; 138 runs have extracted vision measurements; and the workflow exposes four camera-check stages: spread, fold1, fold2 and push-off. Sources: private data/runs.parquet and data/vision.parquet, with the public schemas and commands in documentation/data/pipeline.md and documentation/status.md. The remaining callouts describe implemented data, measurement and review tools.

slides.title: Make the next run more informative

bullets.text: Compare batches using the run table, camera-derived metrics and recipe settings.
Bring more run records and check images into the analysis, then use the evidence to shape the next experiment.

slides.footer: Public code; run data stays private
slides.notes: Invite the audience to explore the public project and its pipeline, data schemas, vision measurements, model artifacts and review tools. Teams can use their own authorized run records to compare batches and shape follow-up experiments. The source code is public; private Maus run data is not included.
